species.name: Gruulk
species.flavour: A green-hided, blue-crested colossus, quiet until the first hit lands; his opening blow is a landslide.

learned.name: Scrap
learned.desc: A cheap, scrappy swing — what you throw while the rage builds.

learned.name: Enrage
learned.desc: Works itself into a fury: +20% damage for 3 rounds.

learned.name: Blood Price
learned.desc: Swung with everything, including what it costs you. Cheap in mana because it is paid for in blood.

learned.name: Reckless Slam
learned.desc: A scorching, reckless haymaker; it burns the arm that throws it.

learned.name: Power Strike
learned.desc: A heavy, committed blow, thrown exactly where it was aimed.

learned.name: Sunder
learned.desc: Splits the guard rather than the body: −12 mitigation for 3 rounds. The setup STR never had.

learned.name: Riposte
learned.desc: Takes the blow to answer it: returns 10 damage on every hit for 2 rounds.

learned.name: Headbutt
learned.desc: Short, ugly, and it rings their bell.

learned.name: Bonebreaker
learned.desc: Shatters defence and leaves them open — the opener Executioner is waiting on.

learned.name: Twist the Knife
learned.desc: Finds the wound someone else already opened, and worsens it.

learned.name: Guard
learned.desc: Brace against the next hits.

learned.name: Cleave
learned.desc: A horizontal sweep through everything in front of it — weak into one body, brutal into three.

learned.name: Intimidate
learned.desc: A roar with a body behind it: the nearest of them break and run.

learned.name: Piercing Shot
learned.desc: One or two venom-tipped shots, and the venom may pass to a neighbour.

learned.name: Sling
learned.desc: One or two quick shots. Cheap enough to throw all day.

learned.name: Sidestep
learned.desc: Footwork. Small, cheap, and always available.

learned.name: Body Slam
learned.desc: Throws its bulk into them and sends them reeling.

learned.name: Seize
learned.desc: Clamps on and hauls them in. They can still fight; they cannot leave.

learned.name: Taunt
learned.desc: Enrages one of them into coming for you, and swinging softer for it.

learned.name: Barbed Carapace

learned.name: Steady Vigil

learned.name: Brace
learned.desc: Small, cheap, always there.
